summary: Plan v11, Phases 0-1 completed and committed (verification spike; sat_timp field added to IBranchSaturation and mechanically discharged at IExpandedConsistent_sat, the sole construction site). Phase 2 (universe/measure invariant threading) blocked on two compounding, verified obstacles: (1) intUniverse/intExpMeasure are declared ~450-950 lines after intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat in Scheme.lean, a genuine forward-reference confirmed by a real build error -- this independently corroborates a prior v6-plan handoff's own decision note about the same forward-declaration constraint; (2) maintaining universe-membership across the F-imp world-creating recursive step needs an intExpandBranches_world_bound lemma (nextWorld <= phi0.complexity + 1) that Scheme.lean documents in three places as an unbuilt 'continuation, see handoff' item, not a mechanical assembly step. No sorry/axiom/vacuous statement was introduced; a broken in-progress edit was reverted (git checkout --) back to the Phase-1-committed green state. Phases 3-7 not attempted (transitively blocked). A positive finding: Phase 3's zero case is easy given the invariant (intExpMeasure <= 0 forces branches = [], contradicting the openBranch result) -- simpler than the plan's own description.

blockers.description: Phase 2's universe/measure invariant threading is blocked by (a) a forward-reference: intUniverse/intExpMeasure are declared after intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat, requiring relocation of ~950 lines of already-landed code; and (b) a missing intExpandBranches_world_bound lemma (nextWorld <= phi0.complexity + 1) needed to maintain universe-membership across the F-imp world-creating step, explicitly documented in-file (Scheme.lean:2025-2038, :2052-2055, :2536-2538) as an unbuilt continuation requiring a new injective worlds-to-imp-positions argument. See handoffs/11_phase2-blocker-findings.md for full evidence and a re-plan recommendation.

decisions_made: Reverted the broken in-progress Phase 2 edit via git checkout -- rather than leaving a non-building state or forcing a sorry/workaround.

Did not attempt the ~950-line intUniverse/intExpMeasure relocation or invent intExpandBranches_world_bound within this dispatch: both are separately-sized units of work, not slack inside Phase 2/3's stated budget.

Recorded that Phase 3's zero case is easy given the invariant (a short contradiction from intExpMeasure <= 0), simpler than the plan's own described argument, so a future dispatch does not re-derive this.
dead_ends: Do not add phi0-dependent hypotheses (hUniv/hMeasure) to intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's signature without first relocating intUniverse/intExpMeasure earlier in the file -- confirmed via a real build error (Function expected at intUniverse/intExpMeasure), not a hypothesis.

Do not assume Phase 2 and Phase 3 are separable at the Lean level: Lean's `induction ... generalizing` automatically sweeps any new hypothesis depending on the generalized variables into the reverted set, so adding hUniv/hMeasure to the signature immediately forces every existing ih/ih_inner call site to supply them -- there is no way to add the hypotheses in Phase 2 and defer their use to Phase 3.
